items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Pee Wee said to me... we didn't have money to walk... to drive... Pee Wee and Art's Back Room... Pee Wee never got too much because I stopped drinking then, and Pee Wee didn't.

ctx.x: This was 1949. It was the Riviera Lounge. Kitty corner from Nick's. And Pee Wee said to me as we -- we didn't have money to walk from 56th Street to the Village -- to drive. The fare was five cents, something like that. So we couldn't spare it.
